message.content:
A non‑stop commercial jet flying directly from **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** to **Miami International Airport (MIA)** typically takes around **five hours**.

| Detail | Typical Value |
|--------|---------------|
| Great-circle distance | ≈ 2,350 mi / 3,780 km |
| Average cruising speed | ≈ 480–530 mph (770–850 kph) |
| Flight time (non‑stop) | **≈ 4 hrs 50 min – 5 hr 20 min** |

*Factors that may shift this figure:*  
- Headwinds/tailwinds along the route (especially over the Gulf Stream).  
- Aircraft type & performance (e.g., Boeing 777 vs Airbus 320).  
- Air traffic routing/holding patterns at departure or arrival airports.  

If you’re planning travel, most airlines schedule LAX→MIA flights in roughly the 5‑hour window, so booking a morning departure will usually get you into Miami mid‑afternoon local time.
